This '''individual''' was a member of the [[Agee]] [[Species/Legends|species]], living on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], it was present in the [[Crystal Jewel]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] when the establishment was rocked by the [[Bombing of the Senate Hall]]. The Agee was stuck on a collapsing portion of the ceiling until [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] rescued it.<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>
